title: MoonDust
description: Cozy and space-like! anyone is welcome here!
body: MoonDust is a cozy MC community. we don't do pay2win because thats lame. we try to make our builds look cute and aesthetic so you don't regret installing minecraft. andd we have skyblock, survival, creative and a buncha other gamemodes so come check it out if you want! bye :)
